## Why it matters

Tempopedia is a digital history directory that lists tools and collections, with topic tags spanning mapping, OCR, newspapers, publishing, and visualization.

It is useful as a discovery aid when planning methods, teaching, or project infrastructure and needing a quick survey of relevant platforms.
